kind.description: Coarse kind from study.BOTTLENECK_KINDS, as on the round ledger.

arm_kind.description: The llm-d arm taxonomy entry; decides what the cold change is and which inner-sweep knobs open. `topology.pd_shape` moves an existing split to a neighbouring xP:yD point (prefill and decode replica counts) and sweeps the P/D knobs there. `operating_point.concurrency` moves a closed-loop (AgentX) workload's sessions-in-flight -- a bench-only change. `engine.role_knob` sets one whitelisted knob on one pool through the recipe's knob map.

incumbent_config_path.description: The current incumbent llmd-config.json. The arm's config is this plus `sets`.

sets.description: Dotted-path assignments applied to the incumbent to form the arm's cold configuration, e.g. {"topology.decode.replicas": 5}. Empty for the baseline arm.

release_name.description: Release name to use; defaults to <study_id>-<arm> truncated.

sweep_budget.description: Maximum inner-loop benchmark runs (hot/warm reconfigures) after the first measurement.

sweep_knobs.description: Hot/warm dotted paths the inner sweep may move for this arm, with the executor choosing values. Default depends on arm_kind.

baseline_value.description: Primary-metric value of the study baseline (or current incumbent) to compute the verdict against.

baseline_harness.description: The baseline's (or incumbent's) provenance.harness_digest. The executor passes it to the evaluator, which refuses a verdict when the arm was measured by a different apparatus.

examples.claim: 5 replicas at max_num_seqs 256 meet the SLO at 120 qps with 4 fewer chips.
